description: Water Sports covers waterskiing and wakeboarding safely: hazards and first aid, Safety Afloat and the Water Sports Safety Code, life jackets, the swimmer test, hand signals, deep-water starts, crossing wakes and falling safely.

safety.note: Water sports follow Safety Afloat with a qualified boat driver and observer; pass the swimmer test and wear a life jacket.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (hazards and first aid, Safety Afloat, life jackets and the Water Sports Safety Code, the swimmer test, and on-water skiing or wakeboarding skills) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
